This is the sixth chapter of the [[Pokémon Mezastar: Aim to Be a Tag Master!]] manga. It was first published in the September 2021 issue of ''[[CoroCoro|CoroCoro Ichiban!]]'', released on July 21, 2021.<ref>[http://web.archive.org/web/20230817235123/https://www.bookshop-ps.com/bsp/bsp_magcode?sha=1&sho=1385909121 ''CoroCoro Ichiban!'' September 2021 issue | Shogakukan BOOK SHOP] (Japanese; archived)</ref><ref>[https://web.archive.org/web/20221201040827/https://corocoro.jp/news/297022/ ''CoroCoro Ichiban!'' September 2021 issue | CoroCoro Comics] (Japanese; archived)</ref><ref>[https://twitter.com/kemonmon/status/1418423790363561992 Kemon Kawamoto on X (Twitter)] (Japanese)</ref> It is 18 pages long.

It was made available on CoroCoro Online on November 18, 2021 and on Weekly CoroCoro Comics on July 15, 2022.
